sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Suresh C. Dwivedi Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri M.C. Chaturvedi learned Senior Advocate assisted by Sri Suresh C. Dwivedi learned Advocate for the respondent-Development Authority.
The petitioner herein seeks disbursement of compensation of the acquired land in Gata No. 504 area 0.079 hectares out of the total area of 0.1580 hectares, which fall in the share of the petitioner herein, acquired for the purpose of construction of Ganga Expressway.
In the written instructions supplied in the Court, taken on record, it is stated that the name of the petitioner herein is recorded in the revenue records over an area of 0.0790 hectares.
The award determining compensation for the acquired land has been declared on 12.9.2022.

The petitioner herein has moved a reference application under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Smt. Shakuntala Devi vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 12 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57840005/
1 Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, which has been forwarded to the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Bareilly.

sentences.text: The submission, thus, is that the petitioner cannot seek any interference in the execution of the project or the possession of the petitioner over the land in question is illegal.

Be that as it may, for the prayer made in the writ petition which is confined to the payment of compensation for the acquired land, we find that the appropriate course of action for the petitioner is to approach the competent authority for disbursement of the compensation strictly, in accordance with the law.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
